{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient_id
df_grouped = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {df_grouped[df_grouped > 1].count()}")"}
